data.summary: Experienced professional with 5+ years overall, including nearly 2 years and 11 months as a QA Test Engineer skilled in manual and automation testing. Currently, I am working as a Business Analyst, utilizing 1 year and 2 months of specialized experience in gathering and analyzing requirements to develop effective business solutions. Known for attention to detail and effective collaboration with cross-functional teams.

all_skills: BRD, FRD, RTM, Use Cases, User Stories

responsibilities: Gathered and analyzed client requirements through stakeholder meetings.
Developed BRD and FRD documents tailored to client needs.
Communicated requirements to development and QA teams.
Managed User Stories and project tasks in JIRA.
Led cross-functional teams and daily stand-ups to monitor progress.
Conducted unit testing and ensured compliance with requirements.
Maintained ongoing client communication for requirement updates.
Managed Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) for complete coverage.
Performed and documented SOAP API testing and integration.
Developed and maintained automated test scripts using Selenium WebDriver and Python.
Executed automated test cases to ensure software quality.
Tested REST APIs with Postman for endpoint and data validation.
Analyzed test results and reported issues to development teams.
Used SQL for database validation and verification.
Troubleshot and debugged automated test failures.
Managed test cases and defects using JIRA.
Collaborated with developers, product managers, and analysts.
Participated in requirement reviews, assessing testability and risks.
Supported QA process improvements and best practices.
Managed below-the-line (BTL) marketing activities to drive outreach and engagement.
Conducted cold calls to promote data science–related courses and successfully converted inquiries into qualified leads.
Worked in a target-driven environment, consistently meeting monthly performance goals.
Clearly explained the importance of skill development to users and guided them on suitable career paths
Designed promotional pamphlets for a self-defense organization using CorelDraw to enhance brand visibility.
Created engaging social media content and managed uploads to promote the organization online.
Developed branding materials including logos, certificates, and bag designs to support marketing initiatives.
Coordinated with multiple vendors to gather quotations and identify cost-effective options for production

projects.name: COMPLAINCE
projects.description: Compliance domain application designed for organizations to manage and track their compliance readiness. The application supports subscription-based access, allowing users to take assessments, upload relevant documents, and receive AI-driven analysis to evaluate compliance levels and identify gaps. The system also facilitates automated generation of policy documents based on assessment outcomes and uploaded content.

projects.name: BIOMETRIC
projects.description: Biometric verification application for MM business, focused on enhancing security through voice and facial recognition. Gathered and analyzed requirements, collaborated with stakeholders, and defined functional specifications to support secure and seamless user authentication.

projects.name: TRAVEL AGENCY
projects.description: The flight booking application, developed for clients Fly High and MSC Cruises, is tailored specifically for travel agencies to streamline ticket reservations. It supports multiple user categories including general passengers, marine personnel, army staff, and crew operators, each with customized booking workflows, fare rules, and document requirements to meet their unique needs.

projects.name: E-PROCUREMENT
projects.description: Procure to Pay (P2P) is an integrated process that manages the procurement and payment of goods and services. It starts with identifying needs and ends with payment to the supplier. Key steps include requisitioning, purchasing, receiving, invoicing, and payment. This process aims to ensure efficiency, compliance, and cost-effectiveness in managing a company's procurement activities.

projects.name: EDUCATION TECHNOLOGY
projects.description: Worked on an experiential learning platform that bridges skill gaps for graduates by identifying industry- required skills and designing tailored boot camps. It assesses college curricula to create bridge programs that up skill candidates according to employers' needs. Integrated with iCapability, iLearn, and iProductivity, the app allows users to register and enroll in skill- building programs. Admins can add mentors, service providers, and create various programs.

projects.name: ENERGY EFFICIENCY
projects.description: The UK's commitment to achieve net-zero carbon emissions by 2050 requires reducing heating emissions, facilitated by effective home insulation in walls, floors, and roofs. The ECO Green Deal replaces earlier schemes, offering grants, loans, and subsidies to enhance energy efficiency in homes. Energy companies like IEO serve as intermediaries, assisting homeowners in qualifying for government-funded boiler replacements or upgrades to support these environmental goals.
